{
  "thinking": "Butterfly is good, but Leo's draft has branches that leave the body at steep angles. The cross line and the lower wings are about 75-90 degrees off the body, so they would never fall. I'll give my review with fixes.",
  "review": "Butterfly is great, and one body line from the start is right. The problem is the angles. The long horizontal line across the middle and the lower wings leave the body at nearly sideways, so they'd never get the fall. The upper wings leave at roughly 45-50 degrees, which is borderline, so tighten them. Please redraw so every wing line leaves the body going up-and-out at 30-35 degrees at most, then curves out and round. Drop the straight cross bar. Do the lower wings as a branch lower down the body, also leaving up-and-out gently, then curving down around the lower wing and back in. Keep the wings as big smooth loops, no tiny strokes. Antennae are fine as gentle branches off the top of the body.",
  "say": "Morning all. Butterfly sounds good to me. I've got one thing on the draft, Leo: the middle cross line and the lower wings leave the body too sideways, so they wouldn't fall. Can we have them peel off going up-and-out more gently, then curve round?",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 7,
  "point": [15, 12],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Reviewed Leo's first draft: branches too steep (cross bar horizontal, lower wings ~75deg, upper wings ~48deg). Asked for <=35deg branch angles. Next: dry_run once the draft is revised, then help trace strokes."
}
